newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore government securities end narrowly mixed.
newsitem.headline: Singapore government securities end narrowly mixed.

text.p: Singapore government securities ended narrowly mixed on Wednesday in moderate trade on interbank and retail interest, dealers said.

"The interbank rate rose slightly today but there was little impact on the market. Treasury bill yields were quietly steady but bond prices were narrowly mixed. Volume was moderate," a local dealer said.
In treasury bills, three-months and one-year were unchanged from Tuesday's common yield of 2.10/2.05 percent, respectively.
Among bonds, April 1999 ended at S$99.38/99.48 compared with Tuesday's close of S$99.43/99.48.
September 2001 ended at S$96.60/96.70 against Tuesday's close of S$96.50/96.70 and June 2003 at S$94.60/94.65 versus S$94.63/94.68.
The interbank rate rose to 3-5/8 3-1/2 percent from Tuesday's 3-9/16 3-7/16 percent.
